name: Orbit Architecture
scope: Art direction, responsive web design, frontend
summary: A portfolio that lets you understand one house through its setting, plan and interiors.
brief: A prospective client should be able to understand an architect’s work before a call. The brief was to explain one building well, with enough context to read the photographs and the plan together.
cover: A modern lakeside residence at dusk
decisions: Start with the site
The exterior establishes where the house sits. The opening photograph leaves room for the landscape and places the building at the edge of the frame.
Give the plan a job
The plan explains how the private rooms, living space and lake-facing terrace connect. It belongs to the project page so visitors keep their place while reading.
Bring the visitor inside
An interior study shifts the scale from the building to its materials, light and view. Captions name the details that a prospective client can ask about.
evidence: Interior of the Lakeside Residence with a concrete ceiling and glazing facing the lake
evidence_caption: Interior study · Light, concrete and the view to the lake
note: Open the prototype and follow the same residence from the exterior to its plan and material study.

name: Vanguard Room Studio
summary: An interactive room for comparing a modular wall system, finishes and lighting.
brief: A finish swatch tells you little about what a wall will look like across a lobby. The concept gives an interior designer enough context to compare options while planning a room.
cover: Isometric room with furniture and a wall of curved fins in Vanguard Room Studio
decisions: Start with a room
A furnished scene provides scale and context. Designers can compare finishes against the same floor and furnishings.
Keep controls close to the result
Changes to the room update the scene. Moving the camera helps you see how the vertical fins read from different angles.
Offer a simpler entry point
The product page gives the Wave 01 wall its own configurator before inviting visitors into the broader Room Studio.
evidence: A curved sequence of vertical wall fins in a lobby
note: Try a different finish, adjust lighting and move around the lobby in the live prototype.

name: Solarium
summary: A clean-energy identity built around one repeating frame, applied to a report and campaign poster.
brief: Build a visual identity that can carry both a technical report and a short campaign message. It needs a recognizable shape that holds up at different sizes and against different images.
cover: Receding architectural frames leading toward a bright opening
cover_caption: Solarium · Architectural reference for the frame
decisions: Build a mark from one form
The nested frame suggests movement through a space and gives the mark a recognizable outline.
Give each colour a role
Solar yellow draws attention to key material. Graphite holds the primary type, and the paper tone carries longer editorial pieces.
Test it on two applications
The report uses the frame to draw the reader into the cover. The poster uses the same shape to lead toward a single message.
note: See the wordmark, colour palette, sample report and campaign poster in the identity prototype.

name: Kronos / Night Shift
scope: Release website, interaction design, audio player
summary: An interactive release built around one night crossing, with two mixes and three downloadable cuts.
brief: A listener should be able to hear what changes in a mix without hunting for the same moment in two tracks. The page also needs to make each downloadable cut easy to preview.
cover: Light-rail train passing a street crossing at night
cover_caption: Crossing 01 · Cropped frame from the source recording
decisions: Keep playback in place
The location recording and the designed mix share the same shot. Switching between them lets the listener compare the same moment.
Make the recording useful
Approach, pass-by and tail are available separately. Each cut has a preview and a WAV link.
Credit the source
The prototype links to the original footage and recording by Grendelkhan and displays its CC BY-SA 4.0 licence.
note: Start playback, switch between the location recording and the Kronos mix, then preview the three individual cuts.
